title: Rodya the Hammer: A Fantasy After Being Dumped
description:
At the “end” of my tears, my life begins to accelerate...

Roja, an adventurer, is left devastated after his lover is stolen away from him. With his party disbanded, he decides to return to his rural hometown, but his “misfortune” leads him toward a true adventure.

Meeting new companions, awakening a power capable of defying the world, and uncovering the hidden truth of the world...

This is the story of a man who lost his purpose in life, his journey to find his way back, and the heroic tale that begins after he does.
author: Maruchun
